sa-a.title: sa a — this / that
sa-a.bodyMarkdown:
Use **sa a** after a noun to point out one thing:

- **valiz sa a** — this/that bag
- **machin sa a** — this/that car

The demonstrative follows the noun.

sa-yo.title: sa yo — these / those
sa-yo.bodyMarkdown:
For more than one thing, use **sa yo**:

- **kaye sa yo** — these/those notebooks
- **liv sa yo** — these/those books

The final **yo** marks the plural.

demonstrative-owner.title: Valiz sa a se pou Mari
demonstrative-owner.bodyMarkdown:
Combine the demonstrative with **se pou**:

- **Valiz sa a se pou Mari.** — This/that bag is Mari's.
- **Kaye sa yo se pou nou.** — These/those notebooks are ours.

This is a practical way to talk about objects around you.
